v3-8.candidate: Abner became very angry over Mephibosheth’s statement. Abner said to him, “Am I a dog’s head? Today I have shown mercy to the house of Saul your father, and toward brothers and acquaintances, and I have not deserted to David’s house. Yet today you call me to account for wrongdoing concerning a woman?

v3-12.candidate: Abner sent messengers to David at Thailam, where he was at the time, saying, “Make your covenant with me, and behold, my hand is with you to turn all the house of Israel to you.”

v3-25.candidate: Do you not know the wickedness of Abner son of Ner? For he came to deceive you, to learn your going out and your coming in, and to learn everything you are doing.”
